# Fixture provenance

`umart_u3225qe.html` is a sanitised minimal fixture derived from the public
Umart U3225QE product page on 2026-08-02:

https://www.umart.com.au/product/dell-ultrasharp-32in-4k-ips-120hz-thunderbolt-hub-monitor-u3225qe-84809

Only the schema.org Product JSON-LD fields required by the parser and the visible
warranty label were retained. Analytics, tracking identifiers, images, reviews,
scripts, cookies, account state, and personalisation data were omitted. Prices
and availability are historical fixture values, not parser expectations.
`ple_32gr93u.html` is a sanitised minimal extraction of PLE's public Product JSON-LD
and relevant visible warranty/stock text, captured 2026-08-02 from the configured URL.
Tracking scripts, session identifiers, images and unrelated navigation were removed.
